g.text: DISCOVERY BEFORE SQL
Definitions and data discovery are useful
tasks in their own right
ILLUSTRATIVE RESPONSE PATH
“What is the meaning of live?”
Look up the authoritative glossary or catalog.
If several definitions match, ask which applies.
Explain the reviewed definition and its source.
Offer a supported example or useful next question.
The actual business meaning of “live” is unknown
in this review. Do not supply an invented meaning.
Make the supported surface discoverable
Offer “What can I ask?”, topic browsing and
supported example questions near the entry point.
Explain unavailable data and unresolved terms.
A definition-only question needs metadata rather
than a source SQL query.
Measure a useful response
Check definition correctness, helpful discovery,
useful next questions and time to useful response.
Proposed experience; grounded lookup and clarification replace an unsupported definition guess.
